# Domain Vocabulary

*Auto-generated from `scripts/reference_papers/`. Run `scripts/setup_writing_style.bat` to populate.*
*Until generated, Claude uses general technical vocabulary.*

## How to generate

1. Drop 2-3 top recent papers from your target field into `scripts/reference_papers/`
2. Run `python scripts/extract_domain_vocabulary.py`
3. This file will be overwritten with field-current terminology.
